description:
Music video directed by Gko for the song Kyuuseishu by Tsukuyomi.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the opening theme of the anime Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu (The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior).
